summary: Full E2E test of 2 new features: (1) Laporan Perbandingan Iuran vs Pencairan report at /laporan/perbandingan, (2) Dashboard Tren CU filter. Backend: created isolated TEST_ workspace (2 CUs, 3 iuran rows, 1 permohonan analyzed+disbursed) and ran 9 pytest tests validating iuran/permohonan filters by cu_id and date range, /api/dashboard/tren with cu_id filter for admin, and petugas scoping. All 9 PASSED. Teardown deletes pencairan->permohonan->iuran->users->CUs and resets settings.nomor_berikutnya=1 — verified no leftover TEST_ data. Frontend (Playwright, admin login): nav-laporan-perbandingan link navigates to /laporan/perbandingan; default radio banding-mode-cu checked; CU view shows 6 rows (all seed CUs CUG-001..006) + totals footer; banding-rasio-total renders 'Rasio total pencairan terhadap iuran: -' (expected since seed has no iuran+cair in 2026); switching to banding-mode-bulan reveals banding-cu select and 12 month rows starting 'Januari'; banding-tahun input defaulted to 2026; report-excel-btn and report-print-btn present. Dashboard dash-tren card renders with admin-only dash-tren-cu selector (Semua + 6 CUs); selecting CUG-001 triggered GET /api/dashboard/tren?cu_id=... and chart updated to CU-scoped values. No console errors, no DOM errors.
critical_code_review_comments: LapPerbandingan.rasio() returns '-' only when iuran=0; division by zero avoided. Good.
LapPerbandingan aggregates with r.analisis?.total_disetujui (approved amount) for cair side and r.total (sanduk+lalau) for iuran side — consistent with other reports.

Backend _tren() (server.py:768) uses doc projection {'_id':0,'tanggal':1,'total':1} for iuran and iterates permohonan with status filter in q; keys built as last 12 months from today. Admin passes cu_id; endpoint /api/dashboard/tren is scoped by current_user (petugas's cu_id ignores the query param override — verified in test_petugas_scoped_to_own_cu).

Dashboard.jsx Tren useEffect only re-fetches when isAdmin (petugas gets the initial payload from /api/dashboard which is already scoped). The isAdmin guard is correct but means the CU selector is only rendered for admin — matches review spec.

Minor: Tren chart in Dashboard uses initial server-side tren even after admin selects back 'Semua'. The 'allowAll' empty value correctly refetches without cu_id; verified via Playwright network call. OK.
seed_data_creation: Only inside module-scoped fixture; fully cleaned up at teardown (pencairan deleted first, then permohonan, iuran, users, CUs; settings.nomor_berikutnya reset to 1).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both review-request features verified end-to-end. Pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_perbandingan_tren.py can be re-used for regression (it is self-contained and cleans up). Seed data (CUG-001..006 x 9 permohonan=54) remains untouched. settings.nomor_berikutnya=1.
